title: 🆕春日上新｜朝阳迷你鲨公路自行车胎来喽！
notes: Official Chaoyang account post (edited 2024-04-11): Mini Shark road tire, an upgrade of the original-equipment tire on XDS and 瑞豹 complete bikes; high-density 'shark-skin' puncture layer between tread and casing, 60 TPI casing, near-slick tread with small blocks and shoulder sipes, for daily training and leisure riding. Replies place the Mini Shark for daily riding and the Falcon for racing and say colour does not change performance. A question about wet grip was unanswered.
